segments.text_en: Cosmic decision and divine selection
evidence: It was time to decide destinies in heaven and on earth
Lagash had raised the head towards heaven in large ‘me’
Enlil looked righteously upon lord Ningirsu
The ‘heart’ of Enlil, it is the river Tigris, did it not bring sweet water?

segments.text_en: Divine command to build Eninnu
evidence: To the house its king spoke
I will make the ‘me’ of Eninnu emerge in heaven and on earth
The brick of deciding destinies lifted the head towards him
‘Build his house!,’ he ordered him

segments.text_en: Gudea's confusion and petition for interpretation
evidence: Gudea, his ‘heart’ is distant
Of what my ‘dark goat’ has revealed to me, its ‘heart’ I did not know
Let me bring my dream to her, to my mother
Nanše, my divine sister from Siraran, may she make its meaning visible for me

segments.text_en: Journey to Nina and prayer at Bagara
evidence: Did he not set foot on his barge?
Towards Nina, her city, on Ininadua, he directed the barge
he sacrificed bread, he poured out cold water
His (Gudea’s) prayer was being heard

segments.text_en: Petition to Gatumdu for protection and sign
evidence: I am a no-mother-haver, you are my mother
You have placed my semen in the inside: you bore me in the cella
You are my big dagger, following my side
With the index finger? of your right hand, ‘stroke’ me with it my lady Gatumdu

segments.text_en: Arrival at Nina and prayer to Nanše
evidence: To her city, Nina, he moored at the port of Nina
In the courtyard of the deity of Siraran the governor raised the head to heaven
he sacrificed bread, he poured out cold water
You are the dream interpreter of the gods

segments.text_en: Recounting of the enigmatic dream
evidence: Inside the dream there was one man, his greatness was like heaven
She held a stylus of purified silver in the hand
he drew the plan of the house
the brick of deciding destinies was placed in the mold for me

segments.text_en: Nanše interprets the dream symbols
evidence: My shepherd, let me, me interpret your dream for you
it is surely my brother Ningirsu
That is surely Nisaba, my sister
that is surely the righteous brick of Eninnu

segments.text_en: Instructions for ritual preparation and offering
evidence: Let me give you instructions, let my instructions be heeded
after you decorated this chariot with purified silver and lapis
after you fashioned his beloved emblem
his beloved harp, ‘dragon of the land’

segments.text_en: Gudea prepares chariot and enters Eninnu
evidence: He broke the seal of his treasure house, he brought out wood
He made it straight for him, for the lapis chariot
He fashioned his beloved emblem for him, he wrote his name on it
Joyfully he entered to him in the house

segments.text_en: Ritual purification and second petition to Ningirsu
evidence: He flattened the hills, he returned accusations
Juniper, the pure tree of the mountain he placed on the fire
I will build your house for you, (but) my sign is my not
Hero you poured out the voice to me about the old order

segments.text_en: Ningirsu reveals the sign and promises abundance
evidence: Gudea, I will surely give you the sign of the building of my house
Like the Anzu, its shriek, makes the heaven tremble
Magan (and) Meluhha will descend from their land
I will let bounty come to you from the heaven

segments.text_en: Dream confirmation and social purification
evidence: Gudea rose, it was a dream
He struck the hand into the goat, his goat is good
He returned ‘sin’ to its house
An impure, a terrible one, a leper(?), he brought out from the city

segments.text_en: Brick molding ritual and site purification
evidence: He laid down the goat by the box, the mold
he gazed righteously at the tooth of the hoe
(For) the platform, he cleanses 24 ‘iku’ of the city for him
The cedar incense, the scent of the gods, its smoke he made

segments.text_en: Levy organization and international submission
evidence: On that day, the governor arranged a levy in his land
In the Gu'edina of Ningirsu he placed a levy
Elam came to him from Elam
Magan and Meluhha, from their land, submitted to him

segments.text_en: Procurement of timber and stone from distant lands
evidence: He cut down its cedars with the great axe
Its large stones, in blocks, he brought
the copper he excavated there in its excess basket(?)
Purified silver is being brought down for Gudea from its mountain

segments.text_en: Divine guidance and site measurement
evidence: Nisaba, the house of wisdom, she opened for him
Enki made the plan of the house right for him
the field was right, he measured it
he placed sticks on its border, he knew himself

segments.text_en: First brick ceremony and divine approval
evidence: The shiny basket, the righteous mold of deciding destinies, he raised to Eninnu
He greased it with honey, butter oil, and fine butter oil
Gudea placed clay in the mold
Utu was pleased with it

segments.text_en: Brick presentation and foundation laying
evidence: he lifted the brick from the mold, it is a shiny throne raised to heaven
he placed the foundation, the wall touched the ground
he gave a blessing, he stroked the brick with flax
It is Anzu spreading its wings over the calfs

segments.text_en: Construction completion and architectural symbolism
evidence: They place the wood of the door
They make the house grow like a mountain
it is the dragon of Abzu rising in its terror
The house raised the head to heaven like a mountain in heaven and earth

segments.text_en: Installation of emblems and naming of stelae
evidence: A stone on its side he laid down as a basin
‘the stela, king filling the courtyard...’ as name of that stone he named
He placed the ‘multitude-eraser’, like a great sign, with Lagash
He build the house of his king with righteousness

segments.text_en: Temple radiance and cosmic integration
evidence: Gudea made Ningirsu’s house go out from the cloud like Utu
made it grow like a mountain of Lapis
like the new moon standing in heaven
The ‘covered house’ of the house is a light floating in the middle of the heavens

segments.text_en: Interior furnishings and sacred zones
evidence: At the war-door of the inner room, where the weapon hang
The cedar doors standing in the house, it is Iškur roaring from heaven
Eninnu, its lock, a bison(?), its pivots, a lion
The lintels leaning on the door, it is a young lioness

segments.text_en: Sanctuary provisions and final praise
evidence: The fear of Eninnu covers all the lands like a garment
From the cow pen, oil deliveries, milk deliveries
The wine-cellar(?) (called) ‘mountain dripping with wine’
For the restoration of Eninnu Ningirsu be praised!
